name: OrcaSlicer MCP
description: Drive a running OrcaSlicer with AI: load models, arrange the plate, tune settings, slice, and analyze results. Talks only to OrcaSlicer on localhost or a host you configure; no cloud calls.

deploymentOptions.description: Run straight from PyPI with uv; no install step.

ORCA_API_TOKEN.description: Remote API token from the OrcaSlicer MCP build (Preferences -> Remote API)

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: App/project/preset status, dirty keys, slice validity, and whether a slice is running.

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Read merged config values (optionally filtered to `keys`).

tools.name: set_config
tools.description: Apply config changes atomically. Returns {applied, errors}. On any invalid key, nothing is applied.

tools.name: slice
tools.description: Start slicing the current plate. Returns started / already_valid / conflict.

tools.name: get_slice_status
tools.description: Current/last slice state, stats, and warnings.

tools.name: get_slice_warnings
tools.description: Just the warnings/errors from the last (or current) slice, plus validity - the

tools.name: get_slice_breakdown
tools.description: Per-feature breakdown of the last slice + a stateless predicted-vs-observed flow check.

tools.name: cancel_slice
tools.description: Abort a running slice, or unwedge a stale 'slicing' state (e.g. after an

tools.name: slice_and_wait
tools.description: Slice (or reuse a valid result) and wait for completion; return final stats + warnings.

tools.name: apply_and_slice
tools.description: Apply config changes, then slice and report the resulting stats/warnings.

tools.name: compare_settings
tools.description: For each value of `key`, slice and collect stats/warnings; restore the original when done.

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: List objects on the current plate: id (stable), name, size_mm, and transform (offset/rotation/scale). [needs M4b]

tools.name: set_object_config
tools.description: Set per-object config overrides on an object by id, e.g. {"wall_loops": 4, "sparse_infill_density": "30%"}. Atomic (nothing applied if any key is invalid). [needs M4c]

tools.name: duplicate_object
tools.description: Duplicate an object on the plate by id (adds a copy, offset from the original). [needs M4b]

tools.name: delete_object
tools.description: Delete an object from the current plate by its id. [needs M4b]

tools.name: transform_object
tools.description: Move/rotate/scale an object by id. translate=[dx,dy,dz] mm (relative), rotate=[rx,ry,rz] degrees (relative), scale=[sx,sy,sz] absolute factor. Provide at least one. [needs M4b]

tools.name: arrange_plate
tools.description: Auto-arrange all objects on the plate (async job; poll get_job_status until idle). [needs M4b]

tools.name: auto_orient
tools.description: Auto-orient all objects for printing (async job; poll get_job_status until idle). [needs M4b]

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Whether the plate job worker is idle (poll after arrange_plate/auto_orient). [needs M4b]

tools.name: watch_events
tools.description: Collect live events (slice.*/config.changed/project.opened) over a bounded window.

tools.name: find_config_keys
tools.description: Find config keys containing `substring` (helps discover among the ~600 keys).

tools.name: diagnose_plate
tools.description: One-call plate diagnosis: app/slice status, objects on the plate, bed + active

tools.name: check_placement
tools.description: Estimate whether every object (plus its skirt/brim ring) fits inside the printable

tools.name: consult
tools.description: Retrieve curated slicing knowledge + saved context notes for a topic,

tools.name: check_profile_physics
tools.description: Deterministic pre-save gate: fetches the live config, overlays optional

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Persist a context fact for future sessions. scope: 'machine:<printer>/<filament>',

tools.name: describe_setting
tools.description: Authoritative definition of one OrcaSlicer setting: label, tooltip, type, unit, range, enum values, default. Offline; works even when OrcaSlicer is not running.

tools.name: search_settings
tools.description: Search settings by keyword across key/label/tooltip; returns compact matches (key, label, category, short tooltip), ranked key/label first. Offline.

tools.name: load_model
tools.description: Load a model file (path on the OrcaSlicer host) onto the current plate.

tools.name: select_preset
tools.description: Select a named preset. type = print|filament|printer. [needs M4a]

tools.name: save_preset
tools.description: Save the currently edited settings as a named user preset (create or update,

tools.name: list_presets
tools.description: List print/filament/printer presets with system/selected/visible flags.

tools.name: set_layer_height
tools.description: Variable layer height for one object. mode='adaptive' (quality 0..1, higher = finer

tools.name: set_height_range
tools.description: Set a per-height-band layer height on an object (e.g. 0-5mm at 0.1mm). Same exact

tools.name: get_preset_config
tools.description: Read the full settings of a named preset without selecting it.

tools.name: delete_preset
tools.description: Delete a USER preset (system presets and the currently-selected one are refused).

tools.name: edit_preset
tools.description: Edit a named preset's settings and persist them: selects it, applies the

tools.name: rename_preset
tools.description: Rename a USER preset: save a copy under the new name, select it, delete the old.

tools.name: get_gcode
tools.description: Retrieve the last successful slice's G-code as text. [needs M4a]

tools.name: render_plate
tools.description: Render a PNG picture of the current plate so you can SEE it.

prompts.name: slice-a-model
prompts.description: Guided load -> check -> slice -> read-back workflow for one model file.

prompts.name: optimize-print-time
prompts.description: Data-driven print-time reduction from a real slice breakdown, never adjectives alone.

prompts.name: edit-preset-safely
prompts.description: Preset change with the physics gate: consult -> set_config -> check_profile_physics -> save_preset.

overview.summary: MCP server that lets Claude or any MCP client operate a real, running OrcaSlicer: load models, arrange plates, tune ~800 settings with a physics sanity gate, slice, and read per-feature results back. Requires the OrcaSlicer MCP build (fork with an embedded, token-authenticated local control API).
